editorial:
Imagine traveling all the way to a remote island to find a missing link in human history, only to bring home a total fraud. That is exactly what happens in this goofy comedy. You follow an anthropologist who thinks he has hit the jackpot when he finds a primitive man. He drags the guy back to New York City to show him off to the world as a scientific marvel. The vibe is light and silly, focusing on the awkward clash between a big city environment and a man pretending to be a caveman. It is the kind of movie that does not take itself seriously and just wants to make you laugh at the chaos.

The acting is surprisingly snappy, and the best part is watching the fake primitive man try to keep his act together while dealing with modern life. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the jokes mostly land. If you enjoy old-school slapstick humor, you will love this. It is a great pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon. You can easily find it by renting it on Apple TV or streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video if you want those crisp visuals. If you are a fan of classic cinema, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the truth finally comes out. The primitive man is actually just a regular guy who was playing a prank or hiding his identity. Once the ruse is exposed, the anthropologist realizes he was tricked the entire time. Instead of a scientific breakthrough, he just has a very embarrassed friend. The movie wraps up with a funny resolution where the characters find common ground and the chaos finally settles down.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old comedies and fish-out-of-water stories.
